name: Delete a batch of session recordings by session ID
description: Delete a batch of session recordings by session ID Delete a batch of session recordings by session ID. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/session_recordings/bulk_delete/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/session_recordings/bulk_delete/
Delete a batch of session recordings by session ID. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. IDs that don't match an existing recording are skipped and counted in `total_requested` but not `deleted_count`.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; body (body)
